create_new_submission: create a new competition submission by uploading a file and recording submission metadata for a team
get_my_submissions: get all submissions for the current user's team as a pandas DataFrame with public scores
update_selected_submissions: update which submissions are selected for a team by providing a list of submission IDs
check_submission_allowed: check if a team is allowed to submit based on daily submission limits and competition end date
create_team: create a new team for a user and initialize team metadata and submission tracking files on Hugging Face Hub
